Metadata.title: Aura Estética | Medical travel coordination in Türkiye
Metadata.description: Clear guidance and coordination for people considering treatment in Türkiye.

Home.title: Your treatment in Türkiye, supported from Spain.
Home.description: Selected clinics and professionals, clear information and coordination throughout the process so you can decide calmly and travel with a plan.
Home.heroAlt: Patient speaking with a coordinator in a bright clinic
Home.cardTitle: Taking your time is part of your care.
Home.cardDescription: Human guidance and coordination at every step.
Home.specialtiesDescription: Explore our coordination areas and learn what information you need before travelling.
Home.trustTitle: We coordinate more than a journey.
Home.trustDescription: We help you understand the process, meet the responsible team, review what is included and plan support before, during and after your stay.
Home.footerRights: Information is indicative and subject to clinical and operational validation.

Specialties.title: Specialties to explore with confidence
Specialties.description: We help you understand available options and coordinate an initial conversation with associated clinics and professionals.
Specialties.processTitle: The process starts before you travel
Specialties.processDescription: We collect what is needed, coordinate communication with the clinic and explain what each proposal includes. Aura does not diagnose or replace the healthcare team.

Lead.title: Let's talk about your case.
Lead.description: An Aura advisor will call to understand what you are looking for, explain the process and tell you what information is needed to contact suitable clinics.
Lead.name: Full name
Lead.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what you would like to explore
Lead.messageHelp: Do not share sensitive medical information in this field.
Lead.companion: I would travel with a companion
Lead.consent: I agree that Aura Estética may contact me about my request.
Lead.pending: The call provides guidance; it does not confirm treatment.
Lead.error: Please review the fields and try again.
Lead.successDescription: Your request was registered with reference {reference}. We will contact you at the selected time.
Lead.privacyNote: We process your data to respond to your contact request. Do not send photographs or medical reports through this form.

Clinics.title: Clinics and professionals
Clinics.description: We are preparing a network of centres and teams that we can present with verifiable information.
Clinics.pendingTitle: We are verifying our partner network.
Clinics.pendingDescription: Before publishing a clinic or professional, we will review specialties, authorisations, available services, languages and follow-up plans.

Process.title: How it works
Process.description: We support you from the first conversation through the coordination of your stay.
Process.oneDescription: We learn about your goal, questions and the specialty you want to explore.
Process.twoDescription: We coordinate information with available clinics and professionals.
Process.threeDescription: We organise the schedule, transfers, accommodation and communication when applicable.
Process.fourTitle: You follow the process with clarity
Process.fourDescription: You receive the available information and follow-up plan agreed with the clinic.

Footer.rights: Information is indicative and subject to clinical and operational validation.
